name: pappdrive
description: A synced, end-to-end encrypted folder for personal apps.

scripts.build: tsup && cp ../../LICENSE . && mkdir -p docs/skill && cp ../../docs/api.md ../../docs/hosts.md ../../docs/llms.txt docs/ && cp ../../docs/skill/SKILL.md docs/skill/ && cp dist/embedded.js ../swift/Sources/Pappdrive/Resources/pappdrive.js && cp dist/embedded.js ../android/pappdrive/src/main/assets/pappdrive.js
scripts.build:sidecar: bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/sidecar/index.ts --outfile dist/pappdrived-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 src/sidecar/index.ts --outfile dist/pappdrived-x64 && lipo -create dist/pappdrived-arm64 dist/pappdrived-x64 -output dist/pappdrived && codesign -f -s - dist/pappdrived && rm dist/pappdrived-arm64 dist/pappdrived-x64
